text: 55 years of audio aggregate nobody has ever done this at number 3

13000 runs Virat Kohli is the first ever. The record used to belong to Ricky Ponting 12662 runs in 330 innings. Kohli went past 18 years 251 innings. Ponting averaged 42 at No. 3. Kohli averages over 61. Ponting made 2900s. There Kohli has 48.

Sangakara, Callis, Williams, and nobody else is even close. And he did all of it a day before his 38th birthday. So is Virat the greatest number 3 of all time? Tell me in the comments and follow for more.
